back.es: te = yourself / you (reflexive or object pronoun for tú), placed before a conjugated verb; '¿te lastimaste?' = 'did you hurt yourself?'

note: The hint is harmless but probably not needed, since only reflexive te fits a 'did you hurt [yourself]?' prompt for one word; it's also good that this card (reflexive te) is clearly different from the other card's 'I love [you]' (te as object).
